name: Chronicle 2.0
tagline: AI-assisted presentation builder that produces polished decks without the generic, over-designed look of typical AI output.
problem: Most AI presentation tools generate visually cluttered or templated slides that feel impersonal and unconvincing to professional audiences. Chronicle 2.0 addresses this by giving users intelligent design assistance while preserving creative control and visual quality. The result is presentations that look crafted, not auto-generated.
useCases: Building investor pitch decks that stand out from AI-generated noise
Creating client-facing proposals with a refined, on-brand aesthetic
Producing internal strategy presentations quickly without sacrificing design quality
Crafting conference or keynote slides that feel custom rather than templated
